name: 34953 · Port St Lucie, FL
findings: ZIP 34953 (Port St Lucie) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34953 (Port St Lucie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34953 (Port St Lucie) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
